name: dsh-yet-another-slider-thingy
description: 接管 DSH composer 的模型位：模型行 + 思考强度滑条（紧凑 / 块面 / 胶囊三种外观只管形状与材质；紧凑与胶囊的拇指可切圆角方 / 圆，全部拇指另有标准 / 大两档；配色独立一层，内置五套——Claude 风 / Codex 风 / 苔原 / 海盐 / 暮玫，可新增、浅深各一套值；逐档 / 平滑拖动；五套特效——流光场 / 密度粒子 / 心跳 / 字符点阵 / 渐变，强度跟档位走：越高越亮、越鲜艳、越快，渐变可自己填多个色标（留空跟随配色）并切正反流向；特效与底部刻度可按外观跟随或单独指定）。Composer model seat with a discrete reasoning-effort slider, three shape-only skins with per-skin knob shapes (rounded square / circle) and a shared two-step knob-size setting, independent editable palettes (five built-ins, light/dark sets), step/smooth dragging, five tier-driven effects (flow field, dust, heartbeat, glyph stream, gradient with editable color stops and direction) and separate effect / label styles.
author: AveritA
